sources.quote:
A supplier may deliver a part only if the approved supplier list contains an approval for that
supplier, that part, the receiving site and the customer.

findings.why: The approved supplier list has HB-620 / PLT-PIN / CUST-NOR approvals for SUP-D (revoked) and SUP-H only. SUP-E has an approval only for HS-410 and has none for HB-620. The list covers this part, plant and customer, so the absence means 'not approved'. The line quoted from REG-ASL for APR-006 is a mismatch with SUP-E on HS-410, shown only to indicate SUP-E's sole entry; the controlling record is that no SUP-E|HB-620 line exists.

sources.quote:
A change of source or a change of material requires Nordhavn approval (PPAP resubmission) before
the first shipment.

findings.why: HB-620 belongs to PRG-Y, a Nordhavn program. Changing the source to Galvanica Eporediese is a change of source and needs written Nordhavn approval (PPAP) before first shipment. No such approval is in the documents.

sources.quote: SC-HB620-POR,HB-620,Porosity grade 2 or better in mount bores

findings.why: The drawing requires die-cast EN AC-46000 (MAT-ALSI9CU3) with porosity grade 2 or better in the mount bores. SUP-E is a coater and has no capability line for MAT-ALSI9CU3 or for casting in REG-CAPABILITIES. Only SUP-D and SUP-H are qualified for it.

sources.quote:
A change of source requires a material certificate (EN 10204 type 3.1) from the new supplier for
the drawing material. Missing certificates are an open question for the supplier quality engineer.

findings.why: REG-CERTIFICATES has no 3.1 certificate from SUP-E for MAT-ALSI9CU3. The SUQ owner, the supplier quality engineer (E. Gallo), has to answer.
